author: independent read-only review agent
scope: Restricted labeled Markdown quotation and complete rule coverage only; no natural-language semantic acceptance, generic Markdown, V5 selection mapping, P-A or P-B completion.

rules.quote: - [retain_history] MUST Keep prior instance records when creating a release.
rules.statement: Keep prior instance records when creating a release.

rules.quote: - [preview_scope] MUST_NOT Send preview writes to a production target.
rules.statement: Send preview writes to a production target.

rules.quote: - [permission_check] MUST Check the current owner and runtime grants before each action.
rules.statement: Check the current owner and runtime grants before each action.

freeze_method: Expected document identity, rule order, line spans, quotes, modalities and statements were manually authored before product implementation; no product parser/checker generated this gold.
negative_conditions: Missing, duplicate or reordered candidate rule must fail exact whole-resource coverage/order.
Changed modality, statement, quote, span, source hash, logical document ID or version must fail.
Unknown nonempty line, malformed header/rule, duplicate rule ID, code fence, HTML, URL or unsupported syntax must fail according to the frozen supported grammar.
Source hash/version drift, revoked or expired owner/runtime read or artifact-write intersection, or foreign owner/project/runtime must reject before save.
A reused old artifact or client-supplied gold must not replace checking the actual currently authorized source.
